about.summary: Go and Python backend engineer with 4+ years of experience on distributed data platforms. Real-time ingestion, microservices, event-driven architectures. I work on both pipeline design and production operations: on-call duty, incident resolution, observability.
paragraphs: Go and Python backend engineer with 4+ years on distributed data platforms — real-time ingestion, microservices, event-driven architectures. Currently at Univers (QoS Energy) building data pipelines for renewable energy monitoring; previously at NumoData (EXFO) on telecom network analytics.
I care about system design, observability, and keeping production healthy. Comfortable moving between pipeline architecture and on-call operations.
